channel.title: Every Movie Plug: Movie and TV News
channel.description: The latest movie and TV news from Every Movie Plug: box office, streaming, renewals and casting.

image.title: Every Movie Plug: Movie and TV News

item.title: Nicolas Cage Says He Was Relieved When Prime Video Canceled Spider-Noir: “Whew, Thank You!”
item.description: Nicolas Cage says he was relieved when Prime Video canceled Spider-Noir after one season, calling it a perfect season. Here is what he said and why it ended.

item.title: James Gunn Steps Down From DC Studios: Why He and Peter Safran Are Leaving and What Happens Next
item.description: James Gunn and Peter Safran are stepping down as DC Studios co-CEOs on December 1. Here is why they are leaving, who replaces them and what it means for the DCU.

item.title: Godzilla Minus Zero Breaks a 24-Year-Old Box Office Record Held by Harry Potter in Japan
item.description: Godzilla Minus Zero broke Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets’ 24-year-old opening-day record in Japan and opened to an estimated $32M in North America.

item.title: Robert Pattinson Reportedly Screen-Tested for James Bond as the 007 Casting Race Tightens
item.description: Robert Pattinson reportedly screen-tested for James Bond in London, joining Callum Turner, Jack Lowden and Josh O’Connor in Amazon MGM’s 007 search.

item.title: Lionsgate Greenlights Animated John Wick Prequel as Keanu Reeves Signs On to Return
item.description: Lionsgate has greenlit its animated John Wick prequel about the Impossible Task, with Keanu Reeves voicing the assassin and Shannon Tindle directing.

item.title: Godzilla Minus Zero Breaks Japan’s Opening-Day Record Ahead of Its North American Debut
item.description: Godzilla Minus Zero earned ¥910 million on its first day in Japan, a live-action record, as the R-rated sequel opens in North America on November 6.

item.title: Jeremy Allen White: The Next Wolverine?
item.description: Jeff Sneider reports Jeremy Allen White has met with Marvel about a role in the X-Men reboot. Marvel has not confirmed a Wolverine casting.

item.title: Johnny Depp Says He Would Return for Pirates of the Caribbean 6 to Give Jack Sparrow a Better Send-Off
item.description: Johnny Depp says he would return as Jack Sparrow in Pirates of the Caribbean 6 to send the franchise off on a better note. Here is where the film stands at Disney.

item.title: Jason Statham and Guy Ritchie Reunite for Netflix Revenge Thriller Dogfight
item.description: Netflix has announced Dogfight, a London-set revenge action film starring Jason Statham and written and directed by Guy Ritchie, with production due to start in early 2027.

item.title: Druski Hosts SNL Nov. 7, Then Collect and Praise Arrives on Netflix in December
item.description: Druski makes his SNL hosting debut Nov. 7, and Netflix premieres his scripted comedy Collect and Praise in December, years after the streamer passed on his pitches.

item.title: Dave Bautista Shows Off 20-Pound Weight Gain on Instagram as God of War Kratos Prep Hits 250
item.description: Dave Bautista posted an Instagram story saying he has gained 20 pounds for Prime Video’s God of War and now weighs 250. Here is where his transformation began, how it compares to Ryan Hurst’s, and…

item.title: James Gunn on DC Casting: Batman “Isn’t Far Away,” Harley Quinn Is Open and Man of Tomorrow Is Nearly Cast
item.description: James Gunn has said the DCU's Batman is not cast yet but casting is close, that he wants the best actor rather than a default movie star, and that Harley Quinn will almost certainly return. Here…

item.title: Netflix's Assassin's Creed Series Reveals Behind-the-Scenes Set Photo as Filming Nears Its End
item.description: Ubisoft has shared a behind-the-scenes photo from the Rome set of Netflix's Assassin's Creed series as production nears completion. Here is what the photo shows, what came before it and what is…

item.title: Hollywood Remembers Sir Patrick Stewart: Tributes From Marvel, Star Trek and Co-Stars
item.description: Sir Patrick Stewart has died at 86. Marvel Studios, the Star Trek family, Hugh Jackman, Seth MacFarlane and the Royal Shakespeare Company are among those paying tribute.

item.title: Walton Goggins Wraps Fallout Season 3 With a Farewell Message From California
item.description: Walton Goggins says he has finished filming Fallout season 3, sharing an Instagram goodbye to the Ghoul makeup. Here is what the post says and what it means for the season.

item.title: Sir Patrick Stewart, Star of Star Trek and X-Men, Dies at 86
item.description: Sir Patrick Stewart, who played Jean-Luc Picard and Professor Charles Xavier, died at his home in Los Angeles on October 28 at age 86, his family announced.

item.title: The Mosquito Bowl Opens October 30: Cast, Release Date and What Critics Are Saying
item.description: Peter Berg's World War II drama The Mosquito Bowl opens in theaters October 30 and streams on Netflix November 25. The cast, the true story behind the game and the first critic reactions.

item.title: Donald Glover to Star in, Write and Direct Netflix’s Live-Action PUBG Series
item.description: Netflix and Krafton are developing a live-action PUBG series with Donald Glover attached to star, write, direct and executive produce alongside his brother Stephen.

item.title: James Gunn Says Harley Quinn Will Almost Certainly Appear in the DCU, With or Without Margot Robbie
item.description: James Gunn says Harley Quinn will almost certainly appear in the DCU, but whether Margot Robbie returns is still undecided. Here is what he said and what comes next.

item.title: HBO Casts Jasper Talbot and Hannah Chinn as James and Lily Potter, Plus Harry Gilby as Charlie Weasley
item.description: HBO has cast Jasper Talbot and Hannah Chinn as James and Lily Potter and Harry Gilby as Charlie Weasley in Harry Potter season 1, which premieres December 25, 2026.
